name: self-evolution-plugin
description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) self-evolution plugin: controlled, verifiable, rollback-safe plugin-level evolution.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @self-evolution/core run build && pnpm --filter @self-evolution/dsh-plugin run build && pnpm --filter @self-evolution/mcp run build && pnpm --filter @self-evolution/toolkit run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @self-evolution/core run typecheck && pnpm --filter @self-evolution/dsh-plugin run typecheck && pnpm --filter @self-evolution/mcp run typecheck
